'''Masteries''' is a game system in ''[[Graveyard Keeper 2]]''. Masteries determine which actions the [[Keeper]] and [[zombies]] can perform. Each action requires a specific type of Mastery. There are five types of Masteries, each represented by a different color and associated with a specific type of action. 

* {{Mastery|Violet}} — associated with [[Corpse|corpses]].
* {{Mastery|Green}} — associated with farming.
* {{Mastery|Red}} — associated with construction.
* {{Mastery|Orange}} — also associated with construction.
* {{Mastery|Blue}} — associated with books.

A certain amount of Mastery is required to craft items at workstations. The Keeper also needs a specific Mastery level to interact with certain elements of the environment, such as chopping down trees or fishing.

== Upgrade mastery ==
Mastery can be increased by equipping [[tools]] or through [[perks]]. The Keeper unlocks perks with [[Inspirations]], with no limit on the number of perks that can be unlocked. Zombies, on the other hand, unlock perks by spending {{Tech|Blue}}, {{Tech|Green}}, and {{Tech|Red}} points and are limited by the number of {{Skull|Red}} they have.

Mastery can also be increased by consuming certain items:
